DIVE INTO WONDER AT
UNDERWATER EXPLORER!
Underwater Explorer is a family run PADI 5 Star Dive Resort in Ponta do Ouro, Mozambique, accommodation right on the beach. With year-round adventure diving on pristine reefs, visitors can encounter sharks, migrating humpback whales, manta rays, and dolphins in a protected Marine Reserve. A range of ocean activities from diving, surfing, kiteboarding, boat trips, and more, just steps from the beachside accommodation. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced diver, Underwater Explorer provides courses and private dive boats led by a professional, safety-concious team.

Saltwater Nomads
April 8, 2025
Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. UnderWater Explorer – Ponta do Ouro, Mozambique
If you’re thinking of diving in Mozambique, Underwater Explorer in Ponta do Ouro is an absolute gem. We spent a week here, and honestly, it was one of the best stays we’ve ever had.
First off, the manager Martin is a total rock star—hands down the happiest man you’ll ever meet. His energy sets the tone for the entire place: welcoming, laid-back, and full of good vibes.
The accommodations are right on the beach, so you’re waking up to the sound of waves every day. The rooms are a bit rustic, but super comfortable. There are loads of shared spaces to chill, filtered water available, and plenty of well-stocked kitchen areas with cooking utensils if you want to prepare your own meals.
Now, the diving. The entire dive staff—Liam, Anício, the boat hands—are simply superb. Each dive starts with a proper dive check on the boat, done together as a team, which made everything feel professional and safe. The vibe on the water is relaxed, but you can tell everyone knows their stuff.
Herb and Elaine, the owners, are hands-on and just genuinely great people. They’ve created more than just a dive resort—it’s a true community. What really stood out is how welcomed we felt everywhere. Whether you’re on a dive, walking through town, or bumping into the instructors after hours, they’ll wave you over to their table, offer a handshake, and happily chat about the day’s dives.
If you're looking for somewhere that feels like home with world-class diving and an amazing sense of community, Underwater Explorers is it. We can’t wait to go back.

ABOUT OUR RESORT
In the heart of Ponta do Ouro, Mozambique is a little piece of heaven, a slither of gold, known as Underwater Explorer. The beauty, view, accessibility and warm family environment, catering for divers and friends, alike. As a family-friendly resort, we ensure everyone from young and old, diver or non-diver enjoys all there is to offer, both underwater and on land. Underwater Explorer is right where you want to be in Southern Mozambique.
We offer a fully equipped PADI 5 Star Dive Centre, right on the beach, walking distance from the launch site and protected swimming area. Wake up in the morning to a view of the sunrise over the sea, and let the day unfold with diving, surfing, kite boarding, foiling or a day at the beach. You don’t have to go anywhere else, at Underwater Explorer you can see what activities the ocean will allow each day, it’s all on your doorstep.
Adventure diving all year round, situated amongst pristine untouched world-class reefs, famous for shark diving and breath-taking sightings of migrating humpback whales, manta rays and dolphins.
OUR TEAM
HERBERT CARTER
OWNER / SKIPPER / DIVE INSTRUCTOR
ELAINE CARTER
CAMP MUM / PUBLIC RELATIONS
VENANCIO MONDLANE
CAMP MANAGER
I started my career in the corporate world in South Africa and then Botswana, worked my way up the ladder to Managing Director of large International Corporate. During my time in South Africa, Ponta Do Ouro was my home away from home, especially at The Whaler now known as Underwater Explorer. After the fire in 2010, I focused my spare time into the rebuild of The Whaler. Little did I know I would do that again many years later when my wife Elaine and I decided to start new lives running this amazing dive centre.
Although I have been diving most of my life, I only advanced to professional levels once I arrived here. I am now in charge of an amazing dive team, boat team, grounds and cleaning team, not to mention the bar which was built for my wedding day.
A gypsy at heart, having lived in many amazing places around the world, I started my career working on dive boats in the Caribbean and on the Great Barrier Reef. I was everything from Deck Crew, to Dive Team, to Chief Stew to Glass-bottom Boat Driver and Tour Guide. After nearly 10 years in the hospitality field, I moved back to Botswana to work in the corporate world. Realising my soul needed more, my husband Herb and I moved to Underwater Explorer in Mozambique to begin our next adventure.
I am nicknamed Camp Mum, and like most Mum’s I am responsible for just about anything and everything to do with everyones health and happiness.
Venancio overseas every aspect of managing this camp. He is charge of all the staff in all sectors, all legal requirements and daily operations. He is always calm and happy and is loved by everyone, staff and guests alike. He started his career at Underwater Explorer as a young man, and has gained the respect of his peers and climbed the ladder of authority. We are so lucky to have him at the head of our team. PS. He hates going out to sea as he gets horribly sea sick 🙂 🙂 🙂
TITO GOMES
HEAD SKIPPER
MARTIN HOLMAN
RESERVATIONS & PR MANAGER
ANISIO CUMBE
DIVE INSTRUCTOR
My passioin for the ocean began as a child when I would spend my time going to sea with the local skippers and learning to be a marinero. As I matured, I realised this was what I wanted to do as my career and was lucky enough to be offered a duel sponsorehip from The Whaler and from a South African NGO. I have worked with many talented skippers sharing our knowledge and skills over my 24 years as a professional skipper. Everyday is a new experience in our paradise called Ponta Do Ouro.
Martin oversees our bookings and customer relations and is without a doubt the happiest man alive. You will never forget this gentle man, who will make your sides ache with laughter and ensure you never want to leave.
Martin Holman born 19th November 1984 in a little town in Zimbabwe called Masvingo, went on my first adventures at a young age of 16 to South Africa in 2002. Whilst working in hosptality in a trendy popular restaurant, I watched the dive school next door certifying students and knew this is what i wanted to do as my career. I paid for my first few dive courses with my tips in 2008, and by 2012 I became a qualified PADI Instructor. I have lived by the coast in South Africa and Mozambique ever since and worked with thousands of excited diving students helping them achieve their dreams. With both Hospitality and Diving experience, my current role is suited exactly to me as reservations manager. I will make sure your holiday with Underwater Explorer offers you everything you wish for. You can t miss me, I am the man who never stops smiling. Happy days yall
My name is Anisio Armando. I’m a PADI dive Instructor since 2023. I have been diving for 10 years now. I did my Open Water to Rescue in 2014 to 2015. I was born and grew up until I was 14 years old inland. At edge of 15 years, I moved to Tofo to live with my old sister. The very interesting story about my journey is that I nearly drowned in a river when I was 11 years old. Because of that I was terrified and my parents didn’t want me to be near the water. During my school holidays I used to go to Tofo to see my sister. That’s where I saw a boat going out with divers for very first time. I had no clue what they were doing underwater. However, seeing them with suits and tanks, it seemed way cool and, I talked to my self “I wanna do that one day”. I heard of Bings Divers which was NGO organization that was working on costal and marine life conservation, they were giving opportunities for young people in Inhambane Province to become professionals divers. I applied for a scholarship and I was selected.

DIVE MASTER SCHOLARSHIP
PATRICK SINGA
HEAD BARMAN
JOAO MARIO
PADI DIVE MASTER

FAQ Underwater Explorers
Skip to content
FAQ
Itinerary:
Meet at Underwater Explorer at time agreed when booking made
Collect equipment, sign indemnities
Briefing for tour
Head down to the launch site, a short beach walk from Underwater Explorer
Board the boat and let the adventure begin 1 to 2 dives (Double Tank)
Return to Underwater Explorer for hot showers, a swim in the pool and an icy refreshment at Charlie’s Bar
What To Bring:
Dive certification card
Towel
Windproof Jacket (Weather dependant)
Bathing suit / Swimming costume
Sunblock
Camera
Own dive equipment if preferred
Seasick medication (if you are prone to seasickness)
Gear Hire:
Don’t have your own? We have gear for hire.  Our staff have everything you may need, and will assist you with finding the right fit for you.
BCD
DV
Cylinder
Fins
Wetsuit
Mask
Weight-belt
Torch
Seasonal Highlights: What to expect in different seasons?
Sea Turtle Nesting Season: November to February
The Migration of Humpback Whales: July to November
Reef Dives: Daily, 365 days a year
Shark Diving: There are always sharks around, but during summer months we expect more action.
